Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you'd like, where you'll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine what's possible. Join us and help the world's leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
 Your role 
 As a Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer with Capgemini, you will operate, secure and industrialize an Agentic AI Platform built primarily on Google Cloud Platform. You will reinforce production operations, improve automation and reliability, and support the integration of Mistral and Google AI services without redesigning the underlying platform.
 In this role you will: 
Operate and enhance the Agentic AI Platform and its GKE environments.
Maintain and prioritize the platform engineering backlog in Jira.
Build production-ready CI/CD pipelines and reusable deployment templates.
Develop and maintain version-controlled Infrastructure-as-Code for agreed platform components.
Strengthen observability through monitoring dashboards, alerts, service-level objectives, and capacity recommendations.
Improve platform reliability, security, compliance, and incident recovery.
Support the integration and operation of Mistral, Vertex AI, and Gemini Enterprise services.
Create operational runbooks covering deployment, recovery, and incident handling.
Collaborate with platform, architecture, cybersecurity, and delivery teams.
Deliver knowledge transfer sessions and concise technical handover documentation.
 Your profile 
5+ years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, or infrastructure roles.
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, GKE/Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform and CI/CD.
Experience operating production platforms and improving delivery automation and reliability.
Knowledge of observability, IAM, API security, and secure production operations.
Experience creating reusable deployment templates and Infrastructure-as-Code.
Strong problem-solving skills and a delivery-focused mindset.
Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, international environment.
Strong cross-team collaboration and stakeholder-management skills.
Clear professional English and the ability to produce concise technical documentation.
 Nice to have 
Experience with Mistral and Google AI services, including Vertex AI or Gemini.
Experience supporting AI or machine-learning platforms in production.
Knowledge of SRE practices, SLOs, and capacity management.
 What you'll love about working here 
 Diverse & Impactful Projects: Develop your expertise across a wide range of missions, technologies, and sectors, with meaningful autonomy and room for initiative.
 Continuous Learning: Access comprehensive training platforms and recognized certifications.
 Flexibility & Balance: Benefit from flexible working policies that allow you to manage your time and work location effectively.
 About Capgemini 
 Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations.
